test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. However, the most consumed tea in the world is Indian tea.

B. Tea was originated in China by its ruler, Shennong.

C. India also has the credit of being the world’s largest producer.

D. This is because of the tropical and sub-tropical climate present here.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **BACD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Tea was originated in China by its ruler, Shennong," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "However, the most consumed tea in the world is Indian tea" **(A)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear the comparison between Chinese and Indian tea.
 
• **The next part,** "India also has the credit of being the world's largest producer," starts the explanation about India’s contribution, indicated by **(C)**.
 
• **Ending with **"This is because of the tropical and sub-tropical climate present here" **(D) **completes the sentence by stating the reason behind India's large production.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BACD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DCAB):** This option starts with "This is because of the tropical and sub-tropical climate present here," which disrupts the logical flow of introducing tea origin first.
 
• **Option 3 (CBAD):** This option starts with "India also has the credit of being the world's largest producer," which is out of context before mentioning tea origin and consumption.
 
• **Option 4 (ABCD):** This option starts with "However, the most consumed tea in the world is Indian tea," missing the introduction about tea origin.
